parts.name: nut_plate
parts.desc: Laser-cut 6061 nut plate on the carrier. How the bed is lifted: the T8 brass nut z_nut rides lead screw leadscrew. Its 22 mm flange is under this 9.525 mm plate and its 10.2 mm barrel goes up through the plate's 16.6 mm hole. The carrier's weight rests on the flange, so when the screw turns, the nut climbs it and lifts the plate (and the carrier and bed) with it; turned the other way, the nut goes down and the carrier follows it under its own weight. The M2.5 pin screw nut_pin (through a 5 mm aluminium sleeve, fixed in the flange) sits in a radial slot in the plate: it stops the nut turning with the screw while letting it float 2.8 mm sideways, so a screw that is not exactly where the plate's hole is does not push the carrier sideways. Nothing clamps the plate to the flange: gravity alone holds it down, which is why the nut-seating study (every nut keeps a positive load with the screws at opposite lead limits) matters. Pushed up: in normal running nothing pushes the bed upward (a nozzle crash pushes it down onto the flanges, and the inductive probe does not touch it), but a hand lifting the bed, or something trapped under the carrier while Z moves down, lifts the plate off the flange with no stop. It re-seats by itself up to about 9.7 mm of lift, while the pin's sleeve is still in its slot (the barrel stays in the hole to 10 mm); beyond that the nut can turn and must be lined up by hand before the bed is lowered onto it.

printer_cfg:
# printer.cfg for printer_v8_1: GENERATED by mechloop from the electrical model. Do not edit by hand;
# change the design and regenerate. Directions (dir_pin '!') and the extruder rotation_distance must be
# confirmed on the machine; PID values come from a simulated PID_CALIBRATE and should be re-run on the real heater.
# Input shaper, pressure advance and probe offsets below are PREDICTIONS from the simulation, each resting on
# assumed values named beside it: re-measure on the machine (SHAPER_CALIBRATE, a pressure-advance test print,
# PROBE_CALIBRATE, BED_MESH_CALIBRATE).

[mcu]
serial: /dev/ttyAMA0
restart_method: command

[printer]
kinematics: cartesian
max_velocity: 250
max_accel: 4000
max_z_velocity: 12
max_z_accel: 200

[stepper_x]
step_pin: PB13
dir_pin: !PB12
enable_pin: !PB14
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40
endstop_pin: ^PC0
position_endstop: 0
position_min: 0
position_max: 180
homing_speed: 50

[tmc2209 stepper_x]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 0
run_current: 0.280
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_y]
step_pin: PB0
dir_pin: PC5
enable_pin: !PB1
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 40
endstop_pin: ^PC1
position_endstop: 214.5
position_min: 0
position_max: 214.5
homing_speed: 50
homing_positive_dir: true

[tmc2209 stepper_y]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 1
run_current: 1.200
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[stepper_z]
step_pin: PB10
dir_pin: !PB2
enable_pin: !PB11
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 2
endstop_pin: probe:z_virtual_endstop
position_min: -1.550
position_max: 183.100
homing_speed: 5
second_homing_speed: 1
homing_retract_dist: 3

[tmc2209 stepper_z]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 2
run_current: 1.000
sense_resistor: 0.110
stealthchop_threshold: 0

[extruder]
step_pin: PB3
dir_pin: !PB4
enable_pin: !PD1
microsteps: 16
rotation_distance: 26.8937
gear_ratio: 11.262:1
full_steps_per_rotation: 400
nozzle_diameter: 0.400
filament_diameter: 1.750
heater_pin: PC8
sensor_type: ATC Semitec 104NT-4-R025H42G
sensor_pin: PA0
control: pid
pid_Kp: 43.601
pid_Ki: 18.167
pid_Kd: 26.161
min_temp: 0
max_temp: 280
max_extrude_only_distance: 100
max_extrude_only_velocity: 60
max_extrude_only_accel: 3000
# pressure advance: equal to the twin's 32 ms melt-flow lag (direct drive, 0.4 mm nozzle: factory pressure-advance values (fitted_parameters.json: extruder_lag_s), range 0.02 to 0.058 s); not measured on this machine, no sweep run: print a pressure-advance test
pressure_advance: 0.0315
pressure_advance_smooth_time: 0.04

[tmc2209 extruder]
uart_pin: PC11
tx_pin: PC10
uart_address: 3
run_current: 0.400
sense_resistor: 0.110

[heater_bed]
heater_pin: PC9
sensor_type: Generic 3950
sensor_pin: PC4
control: pid
pid_Kp: 70.164
pid_Ki: 4.773
pid_Kd: 257.853
min_temp: 0
max_temp: 90

[verify_heater extruder]
max_error: 120
check_gain_time: 20
hysteresis: 5
heating_gain: 2

[verify_heater heater_bed]
max_error: 120
check_gain_time: 60
hysteresis: 5
heating_gain: 2

[fan]
pin: PC6

# fan 'hotend_fan' is wired to the board's +5 V rail: it runs whenever the machine is powered (no firmware section)

# mains relay ahead of the 24 V supply: energised while the firmware runs, dropped on any shutdown
[output_pin ps_on]
pin: PC13
value: 1
shutdown_value: 0

# input shaper: predicted by the twin, not measured: resonance X 78.0 Hz, Y 61.7 Hz (belt stiffness only, no FEA frame stiffness); damping assumed. Run SHAPER_CALIBRATE
[input_shaper]
shaper_type_x: ei
shaper_freq_x: 98.6
damping_ratio_x: 0.065
shaper_type_y: mzv
shaper_freq_y: 62
damping_ratio_y: 0.069

# probe: offsets from the CAD; z_offset from the probe's nominal switching distance on steel (5.0 mm) - set it on the machine with PROBE_CALIBRATE
# that distance: OMRON E2E data sheet CSM_E2E_DS_E_12_4: 5 mm +/-10 % on the standard iron target
[probe]
pin: ^!PC2
x_offset: 0
y_offset: 34.5
z_offset: 3.000
speed: 5
lift_speed: 10
samples: 3
samples_result: median
sample_retract_dist: 2
samples_tolerance: 0.04
samples_tolerance_retries: 3

# Z homes with the probe over the middle of the bed
[safe_z_home]
home_xy_position: 90, 90
speed: 100
z_hop: 5
z_hop_speed: 5

# mesh bounds are probe positions: the bed inset by the probe's edge margin, cut to where the probe can reach
[bed_mesh]
speed: 100
horizontal_move_z: 5
mesh_min: 12, 46.5
mesh_max: 168, 202.5
probe_count: 5, 5
algorithm: lagrange
mesh_pps: 2, 2
fade_start: 1
fade_end: 10
fade_target: 0
split_delta_z: 0.01
zero_reference_position: 90, 124.5
